01_n_relayed_services_coexist.notes: 3/3 relayed Anthropic services side by side in <schema>, none storing a credential, each with its own inference table

sub_a.message: This Anthropic Model Provider Service uses relayed authentication and can only be invoked by a relayed (credential-swapped) request.

sub_b.message: This Anthropic Model Provider Service uses relayed authentication and can only be invoked by a relayed (credential-swapped) request.

sub_c.message: This Anthropic Model Provider Service uses relayed authentication and can only be invoked by a relayed (credential-swapped) request.

02_relay_refuses_without_subscription.notes: every service answers 400 'uses relayed authentication and can only be invoked by a relayed (credential-swapped) request' when no Anthropic credential rides along

03_relay_forwards_caller_credential.notes: fake subscription token reached Anthropic on every service: gateway returns upstream 401 'OAuth access token is invalid.' from provider=anthropic. Nothing stored, nothing swapped in

sub_a.message: Model Provider Service returned error with status code 401: OAuth access token is invalid. Authentication with the model provider failed — verify the credential

04_execute_gates_each_service.notes: test caller (EXECUTE on sub_a only): sub_a reached_anthropic (HTTP 401), sub_b HTTP 403 denied_by_uc, sub_c HTTP 403 denied_by_uc

05_no_org_binding_on_service.notes: no binding: create accepts each organization field with HTTP 200 and silently drops it (stored config is relayed: {}). A relayed service relays ANY subscription token; group grants (row 04) plus per-service usage (row 07) are the control. Confirm with a real cross-subscription call (runbook R2)

06_rate_limit_per_service.notes: 4 calls in a row on sub_a: reached_anthropic → reached_anthropic → rate_limited → rate_limited. A throttled call never reaches Anthropic, so it spends none of that subscription's limit

07_usage_attributes_service_and_caller.notes: 8 (service, requester, status) groups across 3 services and 2 requesters, statuses ['400', '401', '429']; relayed flag true on every call that carried a subscription token (incl. 429s), false on the no-token 400s. UC 403 denials are NOT logged against the service

08_omnigent_launcher_wraps_ug.notes: Omnigent resolves ucode claude --provider <schema>.claude_sub_a --workspace <workspace> … with every Omnigent-injected arg preserved (ucode is ug's legacy name, used when ug is not on PATH). Live session with a real subscription: runbook R3
